text: Hello, sorry to message so late. I'm a foster carer and have a little boy aged 19 months with me. He came out in chickenpox spots yesterday, they're really itchy and he keeps trying to scratch them. His temperature tonight is 39.2. I did the glass test on the spots, I think I did it properly, and they all go pale and fade when I press. Other than the itching he seems himself, I think. Playing, eating a bit. I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing as I'm not sure what's normal with chickenpox in a child this small, and I have to report anything to his social worker too. Sorry again.
